info.title: Wolt Menu API
info.description: Generated from the official Wolt reference at https://developer.wolt.com/docs/api/menu (snapshot captured 2026-06-29 by github.com/Nirbel/wolt-mcp). Do not hand-edit; regenerate with tools/build_specs.py.

post.description: Creates a menu for the venue or replaces the existing one.

500.description: Something went wrong on Wolt's side

schema.description: Menu object describes venue's menu on Wolt.

currency.description: Primary currency of the menu. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

primary_language.description: Primary language of the menu. Two-letter ISO 639-1 language codes.

categories.description: Categories of items available in the menu.

subcategories.description:
Subcategories available for the category. This functionality is only available for retailers. 

If category has items, it cannot have subcategories too.

value.example: Hamburger with fried chicken patty, lettuce and tomato

image_url.description:
URL of the item’s image.

Aspect ratio must be 16:9 and image type must be jpeg with a white background.
Recommended size is 1000 x 562.5.

price.description: The price of the item as it appears to the consumer. The price includes any taxes.

sales_tax_percentage.description:
Tax percentage of the item. The price includes any taxes. 
If a non-null, yet invalid, tax rate is provided, while ‘price’ is set to 0,
Wolt will automatically apply the highest valid tax rate for that country,
to avoid future VAT compliance issues, in case of a price change.

alcohol_percentage.description: Alcohol content percentage of the item.

serving_size.description: Unit of measure for caffeine content in the item.

value.description: Amount of caffeine content in the item. For example, 0.5mg will be 0.5.

weekly_availability.description: Weekly availability time spans for the item.

opening_day.description: Day of the week the category becomes available for sale.

opening_time.description: Hour of the opening day at which the category becomes available for sale.

closing_day.description: Day of the week the category becomes not available for sale.

closing_time.description: Hour of the closing day at which the item becomes not available for sale.

weekly_visibility.description: Weekly visibility for this item. It is used to see whether an item being sold by a venue even if it’s not available at the moment.

opening_day.description: Day of the week the category becomes available for sale.

opening_time.description: Hour of the opening day at which the category becomes available for sale.

closing_day.description: Day of the week the category becomes not available for sale.

closing_time.description: Hour of the closing day at which the item becomes not available for sale.

enabled.description: Indicates whether item is available for sale or not. When `false` the item will not be visible to consumers.

discounted.description: Indicates whether the item is at discount and provide the original price of item along with discount type.

original_price.description: Original price of the item on which discount was applied.

disabled_until.description:
Date and time when the item will be available for sale again.

This field is used to mark an item as temporarily unavailable for sale. If this field is set, then the `enabled` property value is ignored.

delivery_methods.description:
Each item has delivery method availability.

- `takeaway`: An order with this item can be picked up by the consumer from the restaurant or store.
- `homedelivery`: An order with this item can be delivered by a Wolt courier.
- `eatin`: The order can be eaten in the restaurant. This feature has been deprecated at Wolt, so while this delivery method will appear in the menu, it is not supported for consumers.

options.description:
Options available for the item.

NOTE: "nesting" options is possible using "sub_options"; the object "sub_option_values" (from a previous version of this API) is not recommended and in any case can't be used together with "sub_options" (validation will fail such payloads).

type.description: Option type. Options can be single or multi-choice. Single-choice options allow only one value to be selected. Multi-choice options allow more than one value to be selected.

selection_range.description: Maximum and minimum number of values that can be selected within this option (only supported for type: MultiChoice; see examples in fields' description).

max.description: Maximum number of values that can be selected in this multi choice option (eg - a Pizza can have a max of 5 toppings total).

min.description: Minimum number of values that must be selected in this multi choice option (eg - a Pizza that must have at least 1 topping, or a drink selection for a Burger meal).

max_same_selections.description: How many of the same value can be chosen in this option (eg - adding the same topping to the Pizza more than 2 times is not possible).

max_free_selections.description: How many selections of values can be made free of charge (eg all Pizza toppings cost an extra fee, but first 2 are free).

external_data.description: External data for mapping. Also known as "POS ID". Used to identify items on the venue's POS.

values.description: Options values that can be selected as part of the option.

selection_range.description:
Maximum and minimum number of option values that can be selected.

This field is required for `MultiChoice` type option.

max.description: Maximum number of option values that can be selected as part of the multi-choice selection.

min.description: Minimum number of sub-options that can be selected as part of the multi-choice selection.

price.description: The price of the item as it appears to the consumer, including taxes.

enabled.description: Indicates whether option value is available for sale or not. When `false` the item will not be visible to consumers.

default.description:
Default value for option values.

If there are multiple values marked as default then first one is picked.

external_data.description: External data for mapping. Also known as "POS ID". Used to identify items on the venue's POS.

sub_options.description:
Options to be "nested" (hidden) and presented only when this value is chosen; used for complex items, where the some modifier groups should only be visible based on previous selections.

NOTE: up to 3 sub-options can be created per value, each sub-option inherits all functionality of an "option", including the option to further nest sub-options to its "values", up to 3 times total.

name.description:

value.description: Value of the regulatory information field.

weight_in_g.description: Weight of the item in grams. This fields represents the amount per package.

volume_in_ml.description: Volume of the item in milliliters. This fields represents the amount per package.

quantity.description: Quantity of the item. This fields represents the amount per package.

display_unit.description:
A unit of measure for the item. Allowed values: `units`, `weight`, `volume`, `weight_100g`, `volume_100ml`.

If one of the fields for the amount per package: `weight_in_g`, `quantity`, or `volume_in_ml` --- is set then this field is mandatory. 
Its value _must_ correspond to the amount per package which is set, i.e, `volume` or `volume_100ml` for `volume_in_ml`, 
`weight` or `weight_100g` for `weight_in_g`, and `units` for `quantity`. Only one of the amount per package fields can be set at a time.

gtin_barcode.description: GTIN code of the item. Must be a valid GTIN-13 code.

merchant_sku.description: Merchant's own SKU for the item.

price.description: The price of the item as it appears to the consumer, including taxes.

vat_percentage.description: VAT percentage for the deposit. Typically the same as the VAT percentage of the item being sold.

VAT percentage for this add-on (used explicitly when the add-on has its own 'price'). 
For item modifiers (eg extra cheese) it's typically the same as the VAT percentage of the item being sold.
For distinct additional items (eg beverages in a meal) it's based on that additional item's VAT percentage

If a non-null, yet invalid, tax rate is provided, while ‘price’ is set to 0,
Wolt will automatically apply the highest valid tax rate for that country,
to avoid future VAT compliance issues, in case of a price change.

schema.title: Menu

get.description:
Retrieves the menu information for a specific venue. 

The response includes a `resource_url` that can be used to poll for the actual menu details.
The `resource_url` returns a `GetMenuResponse` object with `request_id`, `status`, optional `error`, and optional `menu`.

resource_url.description: URL to poll for the menu. This URL returns a `GetMenuResponse` object.

500.description: Something went wrong on Wolt's side

patch.description:
Allows bulk updating item data such as price and visibility. This saves time and effort as venues can update their menus on the POS or menu management system and the changes will be reflected on the Wolt app.

Matching items between Wolt's menu and your system can be done with `sku`, `gtin` or `external_id`. When a match is found, the item is updated with the data provided in the payload.

500.description: Something went wrong on Wolt's side

data.description:
Items to update.

You must define exactly one of `external_id`, `gtin` or `sku` for each item to update.

external_id.description:
Unique identifier (POS ID or other external ID) for the item to update.

For venues with a full assortment integration, this identifier value should be the `listing_id` value used in the assortment file.

gtin.description:
Unique identifier (global trade item number) for the item to update.

For venues with a full assortment integration, this identifier is NOT supported in this API; to send partial updates with this API, we recommend leveraging the `sku` field.

sku.description:
Unique identifier (stock keeping unit) for the item to update.

For venues with a full assortment integration, this identifier is supported, and should be the same value used for `sku` in the assortment file.

price.description:
Price of the item presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.

For venues with a full assortment integration, updates of this field is supported (with usage of either `external_id` or `sku` as the identifier - see details above).

discounted_price.description:
Discounted price of the item presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.

If this field has a value then `price` field is mandatory.

For venues with a full assortment integration, updates of this field is supported (with usage of either `external_id` or `sku` as the identifier - see details above).

vat_percentage.description:
VAT percentage of the item. For example, 13.5 means 13.50%.
Note: even though this is technically not a required field, it should be sent for all items to avoid rely on the default values Wolt will apply if it's null (or not sent).

For venues with a full assortment integration, updates of this field is NOT supported.

enabled.description:
Controls whether the item is shown to consumers when they browse the venue's items.

For venues with a full assortment integration, updates of this field is supported (with usage of either `external_id` or `sku` as the identifier - see details above).

disabled_until.description:
Date and time when the item will be available for sale again.

This field is used to mark an item as temporarily unavailable for sale.

For venues with a full assortment integration, updates of this field is NOT supported.

in_stock.description:
Controls whether the item is shown out of stock to consumers.

This field should only be used for retail stores. Restaurant users can only disable out of stock items using the `enabled` field.

For venues with a full assortment integration, updates of this field is supported (with usage of either `external_id` or `sku` as the identifier - see details above).

patch.description:
Allows venues to bulk update inventory quantities for items listed on Wolt. This saves time and effort as venues do not need to worry about receiving orders with out of stock items in them.

Integrating using this endpoint improves the consumer experience, preventing them from ordering unavailable items. If an item is out of stock, the venue can indicate that the item is out of stock by marking it "sold out" instead of removing the item from the menu.

Matching items between Wolt's menu and your system can be done with `sku`, `gtin` or `external_id`. When a match is found, the item is updated with the data provided in the payload.

You must define `external_id` for each option value to update.

items.description: Object representing payload to update an option value.

Omitting this field leaves VAT unchanged. Explicitly setting it to `null` removes VAT for this option value, unless `price` is also being updated.
